caption:
Second place at Trilogía Dominical. What the coastal heat of the trail taught me: you do not beat the humidity; you negotiate with it. On a course like this, trail running in Costa Rica becomes a lesson in restraint. If you push too hard too early, the air itself will stop you. You learn to listen to your lungs, respect the shade, and save your strength for the long, exposed stretches near the finish. The podium is a consequence of patience, nothing more.
